Task complete. Summary:

**Reconciled:** DE's Intercompany Payable was missing the EUR 500 ICI-DE-02 charge (CI/CD tooling recharge, supported by DOC-0190). I booked JE-00309 to record it (Dr 6200 Software Subscriptions / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable, EUR 500), bringing DE's payable to EUR 8,300 — which ties exactly to US's supported/invoiced receivable balance (EUR 7,800 + EUR 500, remeasured to USD 9,130 at March's 1.10 rate).

**Flagged (EXC-001):** A USD 1,320 entry (JE-00306, "IC adj DE per call") on the US books has zero supporting documentation — no invoice, agreement, or notes exist anywhere in the document store. Per policy, I did not post any offsetting DE entry to force this to reconcile; it's escalated to the controller for resolution (either support the charge or reverse it).

The DE "Intercompany reconciliation" checklist item is marked **blocked** pending that resolution.
